paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning : developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn , which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖持续的外部来源，以解决一系列知识密集型任务。 现有方法改进了对源内容的访问与组织方式，而智能体记忆系统则能保留先前交互中可重复使用的知识；但同一来源的重复使用仍主要被视为重复访问，而非逐步加深对该来源理解的机会。 我们研究“来源学习”：即针对某个持续存在的权威来源，发展出可重复使用的特定来源能力。 我们通过一个持久化的来源模型来表示这种能力，该模型能够捕捉对来源的可重复使用理解，包括其知识的结构、解释与应用方式。 为了构建并逐步优化此类模型，我们提出了 SourceLearn，它结合了两种互补的学习机制。 “自我导向来源学习”会识别尚未完全理解的内容，并自适应地重新访问来源；而“任务引导来源学习”则利用下游经验，揭示来源知识在组织方式上的局部表示缺口和重复性需求。 在这两种情况下，学习信号决定了哪些内容需要重新审视，而持久化更新则从权威来源中重构而来。 在五个基准测试和三种 LLM 后端中，SourceLearn 在 15 种设置中的 13 种表现最佳，相比 Hybrid RAG 的提升高达 22.6 分，并显著优于静态来源表示和经验记忆基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external sources to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Here, a source denotes an identifiable body of external knowledge, such as a document collection, a code repository, or API documentation. Existing work has substantially improved how such sources are accessed and organized through retrieval, long-context modeling, and structured source representations [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . In parallel, agent-memory methods preserve reusable knowledge acquired from prior interactions so that experience can influence future behavior [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . These directions make source content easier to access and organize, and past experience easier to reuse, but they optimize different objects: source-access methods primarily support query-time use of external knowledge, while agent memory primarily preserves knowledge derived from previous interactions. When many tasks depend on the same source, an additional opportunity arises: the agent can use prior study and task experience to improve how it represents and uses that source. This motivates a complementary learning problem: can repeated interaction with the source progressively develop reusable competence about the source itself, beyond repeatedly accessing its content or simply accumulating task experience?
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在解决知识密集型任务时，越来越依赖外部资源。 此处，“资源”指可识别的外部知识集合，例如文档集、代码库或 API 文档。 现有研究通过检索、长上下文建模和结构化资源表示等方式，显著改进了此类资源的访问与组织方式 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。 与此同时，智能体记忆方法能够保留从先前交互中获得的可复用知识，使经验能够影响未来的行为 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 这些方向使得资源内容更易于访问与组织，过往经验也更易复用，但它们优化的对象不同：资源访问方法主要支持查询时对外部知识的利用，而智能体记忆则主要保留来自先前交互的知识。 当许多任务都依赖同一资源时，便出现了一个额外机会：智能体可以利用先前的学习与任务经验，改进对该资源的表示与使用方式。 这启发了一种互补的学习问题：通过与资源反复互动，是否能够在超越重复访问其内容或简单积累任务经验的基础上，逐步发展出关于该资源本身的复用能力？

paragraphs.en: We call this process source learning . Its goal is to develop source-specific competence : reusable understanding of a source that can be applied to new tasks grounded in that source. Such competence goes beyond retaining or compressing source content: it captures how source knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied, including relationships among concepts, conditions governing their applicability, procedures, and how different pieces of information combine to support future reasoning and action. For example, an agent studying API documentation may learn how prerequisites and dependencies connect multiple calls, enabling it to reason about new combinations of those calls. In our setting, the source is persistent in that it remains available across tasks, and authoritative in that it serves as the reference for factual content. The agent’s accumulated understanding complements rather than replaces direct access to this source. Repeated study and use can reveal gaps in this understanding and guide its refinement, turning source use into a cumulative learning process rather than a sequence of isolated access events.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一过程称为源学习。 其目标是培养针对特定来源的专项能力：即对某一来源形成可重复使用的理解，并能够将其应用于基于该来源的新任务中。 这种能力超越了单纯记忆或压缩来源内容：它涵盖了来源知识的组织方式、解释方法和应用逻辑，包括概念之间的关系、决定其适用性的条件、具体流程，以及不同信息片段如何结合以支持未来的推理和行动。 例如，一个研究 API 文档的智能体可能会学会如何根据前提条件和依赖关系将多个调用连接起来，从而能够推理这些调用的新组合方式。 在我们的设定中，该来源具有持久性，即它在不同任务间始终可用；同时具有权威性，即它作为事实性内容的参考依据。 智能体积累的理解是对该来源的直接访问的补充，而非替代。 反复学习和使用可以揭示这种理解中的不足，并引导其不断完善，使来源的使用从一系列孤立的访问事件转变为一种累积性的学习过程。

paragraphs.en: Developing such competence raises two key challenges. I) What source knowledge should be learned before future tasks are known? A source may contain far more information than should be retained, while a one-pass representation may fail to connect information distributed across the source or capture conditions that are only implicit. Therefore, source learning must identify which knowledge is broadly reusable and organize it into a form that can support future tasks whose exact demands are not yet known. II) How can task-specific feedback improve source-specific competence beyond the task that produced it? Downstream use may expose deficiencies that prior study did not anticipate, but directly retaining the observed answer or correction risks learning the task rather than the source. Effective adaptation must instead use task-level evidence to identify deficiencies in source understanding and address them with reusable, source-grounded knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 培养这种能力会引发两个关键挑战。 I) 在尚未了解未来任务之前，应当学习哪些源知识？ 一个源可能包含远超应保留的信息量，而单次遍历的表示方式可能无法连接分散在源中的信息，或捕捉那些仅以隐含形式存在的条件。 因此，源学习必须识别出哪些知识具有广泛的复用性，并将其组织成一种能够支持未来任务的形式，而这些任务的具體需求尚不明确。 II) 任务特定的反馈如何能在超越产生该反馈的任务之外，提升对源的特定能力？ 下游应用可能会暴露先前学习所未预料到的缺陷，但直接保留观察到的答案或修正，则存在学习任务本身而非源的风险。 有效的适应策略应当利用任务层面的证据来识别源理解中的不足，并通过可复用且以源为基础的知识来解决这些问题。

paragraphs.en: Self-Directed and Task-Guided Source Learning. We develop two complementary mechanisms for progressively building source-specific competence: Self-Directed Source Learning proactively studies the source to deepen incomplete understanding and connect fragmented knowledge, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses deficiencies and recurring demands revealed through downstream tasks to further refine that understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 自我引导与任务导向的源学习。 我们开发两种互补的机制，以逐步构建针对特定来源的能力：自我引导的源学习主动研究该来源，以深化不完整的理解并连接零散的知识；而任务导向的源学习则利用下游任务所揭示的不足和重复需求，进一步精炼这种理解。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented language models incorporate external knowledge through task-time retrieval or retrieval-augmented pretraining [ 10 , 11 , 1 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . Subsequent work improves when and how evidence is accessed through iterative, active, adaptive, or self-reflective retrieval [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] , while long-context methods expose larger portions of the source directly but still face challenges in reliably using distributed information [ 2 , 21 ] . Complementary approaches structure source knowledge: RAPTOR builds hierarchical summaries [ 3 ] ; GraphRAG, LightRAG, GraphReader, and KAG use graph-based structures [ 4 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] ; and HippoRAG, HippoRAG 2, and MemoRAG support associative retrieval, continual knowledge integration, and global memory, respectively [ 5 , 6 , 25 ] . StructRAG constructs task-conditioned representations at inference time [ 26 ] . These approaches primarily improve how source knowledge is accessed, organized, or retained. In contrast, SourceLearn treats competence over a persistent authoritative source as the object of learning itself, progressively refining a reusable source model through continued study and use.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强语言模型通过任务时的检索或检索增强预训练来整合外部知识 [ 10 , 11 , 1 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 后续研究改进了证据访问的时机与方式，包括迭代式、主动式、自适应式或自我反思式的检索方法 [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] ，而长上下文方法虽然能更直接地暴露更大范围的源信息，但在可靠利用分布式信息方面仍面临挑战 [ 2 , 21 ] 。 互补的方法则对源知识进行结构化处理：RAPTOR 构建分层摘要 [ 3 ]；GraphRAG、LightRAG、GraphReader 和 KAG 采用基于图的结构 [ 4 , 22 , 23 , 24 ]；而 HippoRAG、HippoRAG 2 和 MemoRAG 分别支持关联检索、持续知识整合和全局记忆 [ 5 , 6 , 25 ]。 StructRAG 在推理时构建任务相关的表示 [ 26 ]。 这些方法主要改进了源知识的访问、组织或保留方式。 相比之下，SourceLearn 将针对持久权威源的掌握能力本身视为学习的对象，通过持续学习与使用逐步优化一个可重用的源模型。

paragraphs.en: Agent-memory methods enable LLM agents to retain and reuse information accumulated through prior interactions [ 27 , 28 ] . Existing systems maintain conversational, episodic, or hierarchical memories [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 ] , or learn from task experience by retaining feedback, abstracting reusable insights, and acquiring skills or workflows [ 7 , 8 , 33 , 34 ] . More recent work further organizes such experience into structured and revisable representations, including knowledge-graph world models in AriGraph [ 35 ] , interconnected memories in A-MEM [ 9 ] , and procedural memory in ReMe [ 36 ] . SourceLearn differs in the object and authority of learning: task experience is used to reveal deficiencies or recurring representational needs in source understanding, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source rather than stored directly from interaction experience.

paragraphs.en: Tasks and Datasets. We evaluate SourceLearn on five benchmarks spanning document, code, and API sources: MultiDoc2Dial [ 37 ] , NarrativeQA [ 38 ] , and SWE-QA [ 39 ] for source-grounded QA; APIBench [ 40 ] for tool use; and AppWorld [ 41 ] for interactive tasks. Each document collection, story, repository, or API library defines one persistent source. Guidance and test tasks are disjoint and shared across methods; we use three fixed 30%/70% splits except for AppWorld, which uses its official training and test-normal splits. QA answers are judged by GPT-5.6-Luna [ 42 ] , while APIBench and AppWorld use their official evaluators. Full dataset and evaluation details are provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 任务与数据集。 我们在涵盖文档、代码和 API 来源的五个基准数据集上评估 SourceLearn：用于源文本基础问答的 MultiDoc2Dial [ 37 ]、NarrativeQA [ 38 ] 和 SWE-QA [ 39 ]；用于工具使用的 APIBench [ 40 ]；以及用于交互式任务的 AppWorld [ 41 ]。 每个文档集合、故事、代码库或 API 库都定义一个持久的源。 指导信息与测试任务是分离的，并在不同方法间共享；除了使用官方训练集和测试常规分集的 AppWorld 外，我们采用固定的 30%/70% 划分方式。 问答答案由 GPT-5.6-Luna [ 42 ] 进行判断，而 APIBench 和 AppWorld 则使用其官方评估工具。 完整的数据集与评估细节见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: To answer Q1 , Table 1 reports results across all five benchmarks and three backends. SourceLearn achieves the best result in 13 of 15 settings and the second-best in one more, improving over Hybrid RAG by +14.3 , +4.9 , and +13.4 points on average with GPT-5.6-Luna, gpt-oss-120b, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively. The gains span document, code, and API sources and exceed 10 points on four of five benchmarks with both GPT-5.6-Luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. In contrast, RAPTOR, HippoRAG 2, and AWM improve more unevenly across benchmarks, suggesting that progressively learning the source transfers more consistently than static source structuring or retaining task experience alone.

sents.zh: 因此，这两条路径从相同的指导任务中获取了不同的信息：具体的故障修复了源模型中的局部缺陷，而重复出现的表示学习则改变了整个模型对源数据的表示方式；但仅靠其中任何一种都无法恢复完整模型的性能。

paragraphs.en: A natural concern is that the source model is merely a compressed summary of the source. To address Q3 , we examine how its representation changes through learning and whether these changes matter for future tasks ( Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的担忧是，源模型仅仅是源数据的压缩摘要。 为了解决问题 3，我们研究了其表示在学习过程中如何变化，以及这些变化是否对未来的任务产生影响（图 4）。

sents.zh: 为了解决问题 3，我们研究了其表示在学习过程中如何变化，以及这些变化是否对未来的任务产生影响（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Learning changes what is represented. We group source-model units into source overview, facts and attributes, rules, relations and constraints, and procedures. From M 0 M_{0} to M S M_{S} and M T M_{T} , the representation shifts away from isolated look-up content toward structured rules and procedures ( Figure 4 a), while units with explicit applicability conditions rise from roughly 30% in M 0 M_{0} to 65–82% in M T M_{T} across sources ( Figure 4 b). Thus, source learning reorganizes what is represented rather than merely retaining more content.

paragraphs.en: The learned representation is more useful for future tasks. The share of source claims required by test questions that are represented in the model rises from 23.2% in M 0 M_{0} to 40.0% in M T M_{T} , with consistent gains across QA benchmarks ( Figure 4 c). This coverage is associated with downstream success: accuracy rises from 67.5% when none of the required claims are represented to 86.6% when all are represented ( Figure 4 d). paragraphs.en: We formulate source learning as turning repeated interaction with a persistent authoritative source into the cumulative development of reusable source-specific competence , rather than repeated source access or accumulation of task experience. We represent this competence with a persistent and revisable source model and propose SourceLearn , which develops it through complementary Self-Directed and Task-Guided Source Learning while grounding persistent updates in the original source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn substantially improves overall same-source task performance over task-local retrieval, static source representations, and experience-based memory. Our analyses further show that source learning progressively makes conditions, procedures, exceptions, and relations explicit and increases coverage of the source knowledge required by future tasks, providing evidence that the learned source model goes beyond static compression. A current limitation is scope: we focus on persistent, authoritative, and relatively stable sources with repeated same-source tasks; extending source learning to evolving, noisy, or conflicting sources remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将源学习定义为：将与持久且权威的源的重复互动转化为可重复使用的源特定能力的累积性发展，而非重复访问源或积累任务经验。 我们用一种持久且可修订的源模型来表示这种能力，并提出了 SourceLearn。它通过互补的自我导向和任务引导的源学习来发展这种能力，同时将持久的更新锚定在原始源上。 在五个基准测试和三种 LLM 后端中，SourceLearn 在相同源的总体任务表现上显著优于任务局部检索、静态源表示和经验记忆。 我们的分析进一步表明，源学习能够逐步明确条件、流程、例外和关系，并扩大未来任务所需源知识的覆盖范围，这证明了所学习的源模型超越了静态压缩的范畴。 当前的一个局限在于其范围：我们专注于持久、权威且相对稳定的源以及重复的相同源任务；将源学习扩展到动态变化、存在噪声或相互冲突的源，仍然是未来研究的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: Every benchmark is cast into the same form: a persistent source, a set of guidance tasks 𝒢 \mathcal{G} used for learning, and a disjoint set of test tasks grounded in the same source. On the three QA benchmarks and APIBench, the tasks of each source are split into 30% guidance and 70% test tasks under three fixed seeds, keeping related tasks (questions from the same dialogue, queries for the same API) on the same side; the same splits are used by every method and backend.

paragraphs.en: SWE-QA [ 39 ] . Repository-level questions about the design and behavior of Python projects. We use six of the fifteen official repositories, chosen to span project kinds and sizes: streamlink (media streaming CLI), sphinx (documentation generator), xarray (labelled N-D arrays), pytest (testing framework), flask (web framework), and conan (C/C++ package manager). Each repository at its pinned commit is one source, consisting of its source code, documentation, and configuration files, with 48 questions.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-QA [ 39 ] . 关于 Python 项目设计与行为的仓库级问题。 我们从十五个官方仓库中选择了六个，涵盖不同种类和规模的项目：streamlink（媒体流式传输 CLI）、sphinx（文档生成器）、xarray（带标签的 N-D 数组）、pytest（测试框架）、flask（Web 框架）和 conan（C/C++ 包管理器）。 每个仓库在其固定提交版本中都是一个源，包含其源代码、文档和配置文件，共有 48 个问题。

paragraphs.en: APIBench [ 40 ] . Instructions that must be fulfilled by a call to the correct API of a model hub. The documentation of a hub is one source: TorchHub (186 instructions), HuggingFace (100), and TensorFlow Hub (100). Correctness is decided by the official AST-based functionality evaluator; a query whose prompt exceeds the context window of a backend is counted as a failure. The three hubs are reported as one benchmark by averaging their accuracies.

paragraphs.en: AppWorld [ 41 ] . Everyday tasks that an agent completes by writing code against the APIs of nine simulated apps. The environment’s API documentation (457 API specifications) is a single source. We use the official splits: the 90 training tasks are the guidance tasks and the 168 tasks of test-normal are the test tasks. The built-in documentation app is removed for every method, so that API documentation is reachable only through each method’s own access to the source. We report the official task goal completion (TGC).
paragraphs.zh: AppWorld [ 41 ] . 智能体通过编写代码调用九个模拟应用程序的 API 来完成日常任务。 环境的 API 文档（457 个 API 规范）是一个统一来源。 我们使用官方划分：90 个训练任务是指导任务，而 168 个 test-normal 任务是测试任务。 每个方法都移除了内置的文档应用程序，因此只能通过每个方法自身对源代码的访问来获取 API 文档。 我们报告官方的任务目标完成度（TGC）。

paragraphs.en: Judging. On the QA benchmarks, an answer is judged correct if it makes the same key claims as the reference answer without contradicting it. The judge is GPT-5.6-Luna [ 42 ] at medium reasoning effort for every method, backend, and split. Accuracy is macro-averaged over the sources of a benchmark and then averaged over the three splits. APIBench and AppWorld use their official evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 判断。 在问答基准测试中，如果答案与参考答案提出的关键主张一致且没有与其矛盾，则该答案被判定为正确。 对于每种方法、后端和分集，判断器均为 GPT-5.6-Luna [ 42 ]，并采用中等推理强度。 准确率首先按基准测试的各个来源进行宏观平均，然后再对三个分集进行平均。 APIBench 和 AppWorld 使用其官方评估器。

paragraphs.en: At task time, SourceLearn combines retrieved evidence R ⁡ ( D , q ) R(D,q) with the activated source model ( Eq. 7 ). We isolate their roles by degrading retrieval on MultiDoc2Dial, whose questions provide gold-document labels ( Figure 5 ). With no retrieved evidence, the source model alone performs comparably to Hybrid RAG with all eight retrieved elements, and SourceLearn degrades substantially more slowly as retrieval is reduced. Removing the gold document lowers Hybrid RAG by about 25 points but SourceLearn by only about 8. These results show that the learned source model provides reusable source understanding when task-local retrieval is incomplete, while remaining complementary to direct access to the source.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务执行时，SourceLearn 将检索到的证据 R⁡(D,q) 与激活的源模型（公式 7）相结合。 我们通过削弱 MultiDoc2Dial 上的检索能力来分离它们各自的作用，该数据集的问题提供了黄金文档标签（图 5）。 在没有检索证据的情况下，仅使用源模型的表现与使用全部八个检索元素的 Hybrid RAG 相当；随着检索能力的减弱，SourceLearn 的性能下降速度明显更慢。 移除黄金文档会使 Hybrid RAG 的性能下降约 25 分，而 SourceLearn 仅下降约 8 分。 这些结果表明，当任务相关的局部检索不完整时，学习到的源模型能够提供可复用的源理解能力，同时仍然与直接访问源数据形成互补。

paragraphs.en: A central principle of SourceLearn is that learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source ( Eq. 5 ). We audit this property on one document, code, and API source by judging sampled units from M 0 M_{0} , M S M_{S} , and M T M_{T} against their cited source evidence, and by checking whether content removed during rewriting remains represented afterward ( Tabs. 3 and 4 ). Direct contradictions remain rare ( ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% ), and 93–100% of dropped claims are preserved after rewriting. However, some Task-Guided units on the document and code sources are only partially supported or unsupported, showing that the learned representation is not itself a replacement for the source. This supports our design of keeping the original source authoritative and directly accessible while using the source model as accumulated, reusable understanding.
paragraphs.zh: SourceLearn 的一个核心原则是：学习信号决定了哪些内容需要重新考虑，而持续更新则从权威来源中重构（公式 5）。 我们通过将 M₀、M_S 和 M_T 中采样的单元与其引用的来源证据进行比对，并检查重写过程中删除的内容在后续是否仍然存在，来验证这一特性（表 3 和表 4）。 直接矛盾仍然很少见（≤ 1%），且 93–100% 的被舍弃的论断在重写后仍得以保留。 然而，文档和代码来源中的一些任务引导型单元仅得到部分支持或完全缺乏支持，这表明所学到的表示本身并不能替代原始来源。 这支持了我们的设计：在将源模型用作可积累、可重用的理解基础的同时，保持原始来源的权威性和直接可访问性。

sents.en: Direct contradictions remain rare ( ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% ), and 93–100% of dropped claims are preserved after rewriting.
sents.zh: 直接矛盾仍然很少见（≤ 1%），且 93–100% 的被舍弃的论断在重写后仍得以保留。

sents.en: However, some Task-Guided units on the document and code sources are only partially supported or unsupported, showing that the learned representation is not itself a replacement for the source.
sents.zh: 然而，文档和代码来源中的一些任务引导型单元仅得到部分支持或完全缺乏支持，这表明所学到的表示本身并不能替代原始来源。

sents.en: This supports our design of keeping the original source authoritative and directly accessible while using the source model as accumulated, reusable understanding.
sents.zh: 这支持了我们的设计：在将源模型用作可积累、可重用的理解基础的同时，保持原始来源的权威性和直接可访问性。

paragraphs.en: Task-Guided Source Learning is intended to turn task experience into reusable source understanding rather than task-specific corrections. We therefore partition test questions according to whether their source region overlaps with any guidance task of the same split. As shown in Tab. 5 , SourceLearn improves over Hybrid RAG by 14.9 points on seen regions and 12.1 points on unseen regions. The comparable gain on unseen regions shows that the benefit extends beyond source regions directly exposed by the guidance tasks, supporting the transfer of learned source understanding to new parts of the same source.
paragraphs.zh: 任务引导源学习旨在将任务经验转化为可重复使用的源理解，而非针对特定任务的修正。 因此，我们根据测试问题其源区域是否与同一分片中的任何指导任务重叠来对其进行划分。 如表 5 所示，SourceLearn 在已见区域上的表现比 Hybrid RAG 提升了 14.9 分，在未见区域上提升了 12.1 分。 在未见区域上取得的相当提升表明，这种优势不仅限于指导任务直接暴露的源区域，也支持将所学到的源理解迁移到同一源的新的部分。

paragraphs.en: SourceLearn uses one Inspect–Study–Consolidate cycle by default. We extend Self-Directed Source Learning to four cycles on two MultiDoc2Dial sources to test whether repeated study provides further gains ( Tab. 6 ). Additional cycles continue to generate observations and expand the source model, but accuracy shows no consistent improvement beyond the first cycle. This suggests diminishing returns from repeated self-directed study, motivating the single-cycle setting used throughout the main experiments.
paragraphs.zh: SourceLearn 默认使用一个“检查–学习–巩固”循环。 我们将自我导向源学习扩展到两个 MultiDoc2Dial 源上的四个循环，以测试重复学习是否能带来进一步的提升（表 6）。 额外的循环会继续生成观察结果并扩展源模型，但准确率在第一轮循环之后并未表现出持续的提升。 这表明重复的自我导向学习存在收益递减效应，因此我们在主要实验中采用了单循环设置。

paragraphs.en: Given the inspection observations, the planner selects the next batch Γ b \Gamma_{b} of Deepen and Connect actions, each with one focused study question ( Eq. 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 根据检查观察结果，规划器会选择下一批 Deepen 和 Connect 动作 Γ b \Gamma_{b}，每个动作都包含一个聚焦研究问题（公式 10）。

paragraphs.en: Consolidation rewrites one region from its current units, the accumulated notes, and their evidence; every proposed unit then passes the grounding gate, and the rewrite is committed only if the preservation check finds no lost meaning ( Eq. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 整合过程会基于当前单元、累积的笔记及其证据，对某个区域进行重写；随后，每个拟议的单元都会通过接地门，并且只有当保留性检查未发现任何意义丢失时，该重写才会被提交（公式 5）。

paragraphs.en: Each guidance task yields at most one representation lesson ℓ t \ell_{t} , and the lessons are aggregated into the representation policy Π 1 \Pi_{1} ( Eq. 13 ), whose rendered text is appended to every writer prompt during recalibration ( Eq. 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个指导任务最多产生一个表示教训 ℓ t \ell_{t}，这些教训被汇总到表示策略 Π 1 \Pi_{1}（公式 13）中，其渲染后的文本会在重新校准期间附加到每个写作者提示中（公式 14）。
